title: AdicFiniteEtaleTransitions
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $A$ a commutative Noetherian ring and $J$ an ideal. Use constant coefficient sheaves, module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The normalized constructions are [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. For $N$ in the pro-etale derived category put $P_n=A/J^{n+1}$ and $N_n=N\otimes_A^L P_n$, and let $
u^*$ be the recorded comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $a,b$ be integers. Suppose that for every $n$ a bounded constructible etale $P_n$-complex $C_n$ of Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ [def-pe-etale-constructible-module, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude] and an arbitrary isomorphism $\alpha_n:
u^*C_n\simeq N_n$ are given. Then there exist isomorphisms $ eta_{m,n}:C_m\otimes^L_{P_m}P_n\simeq C_n$ for every $n\le m$. They satisfy the quotient cocycle under the specified scalar reassociation and the equality $
u^*( eta_{m,n})\alpha_n=	heta_{m,n}^{-1}(\alpha_m\otimes^L P_n)ho_{m,n}$, where $	heta$ is the normalized scalar/comparison isomorphism. Identity quotient maps are included. No completeness of $N$ or normalization of $\alpha_0$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09C2, lemma-describe-constructible-complexes; Tag 09AL, lemma-compare-constructible-derived; parent proof steps specified below.

proof.text: For each scalar extension E_(m,n)(C_m), apply the proved arbitrary scalar-extension cohomology bound to the supplied Tor interval. This gives boundedness without proving constructibility of the extension.

Identify adicFinitePullback with canonical exact comparison through its localization factorization. The existing bounded classical comparison theorem gives bijectivity on Hom sets between any bounded objects. The supplied bounded constructibility of C_n is used only for its cohomological bound.

For every n <= m form theta_(m,n)^(-1) followed by extension(alpha_m), rho_(m,n), and alpha_n^(-1). Lift this isomorphism and its inverse through those Hom-set bijections. Apply injectivity on endomorphisms to show the lifts compose to identities. Cancel alpha_n^(-1) alpha_n to obtain the required compatibility equation. The private Lean helper liftIsoOnProperty proves this categorical argument.

For r >= m >= n, the double scalar extension is bounded because extension(beta_(r,m)) identifies it with the bounded single extension of C_m. Apply injectivity of comparison to the two desired morphisms and cancel the isomorphism alpha_n. Substitute the compatibility equations, the normalized comparison-composition square and naturality of scalar reassociation at alpha_r. Substitute the canonical reduction cocycle. Naturality of theta_(m,n)^(-1) at beta_(r,m) and the compatibility equation for beta_(r,m) identify the remaining composites. This complete Lean calculation includes all repeated indices.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AL and 09C2. D3, 2026-10-26: use bounded classical full faithfulness, bypassing scalar-extension constructibility; explicit Lean lifting and cocycle cancellation, with separate exact-comparison and normalization substeps.

theorem adicFiniteEtale_transitions
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (N : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A)
    (a b : ℤ)
    (Cn : ∀ n : ℕ, adicFiniteEtale.{u, v} X J n)
    (hCn : ∀ n : ℕ, IsCoefficientBoundedConstructibleEtale.{u, v} X
      (adicFiniteCoeff J n) (Cn n))
    (hTor : ∀ n : ℕ, HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude
      (constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) (adicFiniteCoeff J n)) (Cn n) a b)
    (alpha : ∀ n : ℕ, (adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n)).obj (Cn n) ≅
      adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N n) :
    ∃ beta : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
        (adicFiniteExtension (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
          (adicFiniteFactor J h)).obj (Cn m) ≅ Cn n,
    (∀ (r m n : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m) (hmr : m ≤ r),
        (adicFiniteExtensionComp (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
          (adicFiniteFactor J hmr) (adicFiniteFactor J hnm)
          (adicFiniteFactor J (hnm.trans hmr)) (adicFiniteFactorComp J hnm hmr)).hom.app
            (Cn r) ≫ (beta (hnm.trans hmr)).hom =
        (adicFiniteExtension (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
          (adicFiniteFactor J hnm)).map (beta hmr).hom ≫ (beta hnm).hom) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
        (adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n)).map (beta h).hom ≫ (alpha n).hom =
        (adicFiniteComparison.{u, v} X (adicFiniteFactor J h)).inv.app (Cn m) ≫
          (adicFiniteExtension (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
            (adicFiniteFactor J h)).map (alpha m).hom ≫ (adicFiniteRho.{u, v} X J N h).hom)
